learned: 2026-10-17: dankbydefinition.com/coa (Squarespace) renders a table from a script, /s/<timestamp>_dank-coa-master.js, defining window.DANK_COA_ROWS = [[category, subcategory, product, batch, coa_url, tested, thc, is_new, lab_sample_id]], ~1,730 rows (FLOWER, PRE-ROLLS, INFUSED PRE-ROLLS). Lab: Kaycha (ny.yourcoa.com).
notes: coa_url is Kaycha's viewer page; the PDF is coa-download/<lab sample id> and needs the query string, or the server returns HTML.
Text is 'PRODUCT | BATCH | CATEGORY SUBCATEGORY': the product is the strain, the batch the lot.
